# Ehoro Village
> AI programs and learning practice in the New York metro area, led by Ade Ijidakinro (Program Manager, AI & Learning) since 2024.

## Core facts
- Name: Ehoro Village
- What it does: AI workflow programs with quality checks; AI workshops for nonprofits, libraries, schools and small teams ("AI in an Afternoon"); AI visibility checks for local businesses in South Orange and Maplewood, NJ; learning design; a public product lab.
- Area served: Essex County, New Jersey and New York City; online
- Program lead: Ade Ijidakinro, Program Manager, AI & Learning (M.S. Information/HCI and B.A., University of Michigan; PSM I). LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/adeijidakinro
- Contact: hello@ehorovillage.com

## Work (details: https://www.ehorovillage.com/work.html)
- Directed a five-model AI production program (Claude, ChatGPT, DeepSeek, Gemini, Codex) that shipped a 113-adventure narrative game (Rich Alucard) in about three weeks.
- Quality audits that caught tests reporting success while 6 of 9 game modes did nothing.
- A documented AI-assisted method across 24+ build sessions.
- Lo-Fi Spirits: a live lo-fi study companion web app, 45 documented releases (https://www.ehorovillage.com/village.html).

## Services (details: https://www.ehorovillage.com/services.html)
- AI in an Afternoon: a 90-minute workshop on a team's real tasks, with an AI-use policy starter. Launch price $500 for the first three teams.
- AI Visibility Check: free one-page check for local businesses; fix sprint from $99 at launch.
